content.text: Hello English learners and welcome to EnglishPod. My name is Erica and I'm here with...
content.trans: 你好，英语学习者和欢迎来到英语pod。我的名字是艾瑞克，今天我在这里。
对不起，我无法直接翻译中文到中文。不过，根据你的描述，这句话的意思是：

content.text: I'm coming! Hurry up Marco, we've got a lesson!
content.trans: 英语：我来了！莫克罗，我们有课了！

content.text: Okay, I'm here, I'm here. What did I miss?
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请告诉我更多关于您需要翻译的文本。

content.text: Alright, sorry about that. We have a great lesson for you today. We have an elementary lesson.
content.trans: 好的，我已经准确地翻译了您提供的内容。如果您有任何其他需要帮助的，请随时告诉我！

content.text: That's right, an elementary lesson about being in a rush and about giving directions when you're in a car.
content.trans: 英语：那对，关于在车里急着找方向的教训。

content.text: Exactly. We're going to listen to two friends who are getting in a car and they're getting ready to go somewhere
content.trans: 是的。我们将听取两位朋友，他们即将出发去某个地方。

content.text: and they're in a big hurry. So let's hurry up and listen to the dialogue.
content.trans: 英语：和他们大忙大忙的。所以让我们赶紧听对话。

content.text: Hurry up, get in. I'm in, let's go.
content.trans: 英语：赶紧上车，快点跟上。我在这儿呢，咱们去吧。

content.text: Okay, make a left here. No wait, I meant make a right! Come on, speed up!
content.trans: 好的，向左走。不用等，我本意是向右走！加油，快点！

content.text: Geez, what's the rush? Don't worry about it, just drive. No, the light is about to change, step on it.
content.trans: 英语：嘿，快点！别担心，直接开。对了，光圈要调整一下，小心啊。

content.text: Are you nuts? I'm not going to run a red light.
content.trans: 英语：你疯了吗？我不能开红灯。

content.text: Whatever, just turn right here. The freeway will be packed in this hour. Let's take a side street.
content.trans: 无论怎样，就向右转。这个高速路将会在这个小时内被堵住。我们还是走一个侧路。

content.text: Go on, get out of our way! Move, move!
content.trans: 请继续，别靠近我们！前进，前进！

content.text: What's your problem? Geez, having a fit is not going to help.
content.trans: 英语：你有什么问题？真是气急败坏，不解决问题只会更糟。

content.text: Here, I know a shortcut. Just go down here and we'll cut through Ashburn Heights.
content.trans: 在这里，我知道一个捷径。只要走这里，我们就能穿过安斯伯格山丘。

content.text: Let's go, let's go! Watch out for that lady. I'm going as fast as I can.
content.trans: 让我们出发吧，快点！我得赶紧跟上她。

content.text: Yes, we made it. 558 just before the library closes. You're such a geek.
content.trans: 是的，我们做到了。图书馆明天就要关闭了。你真是个天才！

content.text: So they were in a hurry and it was all just to get to the library.
content.trans: 所以他们匆忙赶去图书馆，一切只是为了到达那里。

content.text: Well, maybe he was late returning a book or something.
content.trans: 英语：嗯，也许他可能晚点归还一本书或什么的。

content.text: That's a bit dramatic just for returning a book.
content.trans: 这个有点戏剧化，只是为了归还一本书。

content.text: All right, why don't we look at our language takeaway for today?
content.trans: 好的，我将根据提供的标准进行翻译：

content.text: Okay, on today's language takeaway we have five words for you today.
content.trans: 好的，今天我们的语言小贴士有五句话给你听。

content.text: Five really important and useful words that we found in our dialogue.
content.trans: 五句话我们从对话中学到的非常有用的东西。

content.text: So let's take a look at the first one. Step on it.
content.trans: 英语：所以让我们来看看第一个。踩一下。

content.text: So what does it mean when I tell you to step on it?
content.trans: 英语：所以当你告诉我卸下重担时，它意味着什么？

content.text: Drive faster, right? Step on it.
content.trans: 英语：开快点，对吗？踩上去。

content.text: Exactly. You might also say speed up.
content.trans: 正确：英语：Exactly. 你或许也可以这么说。

content.text: That's exactly it. Our second word, speed up.
content.trans: 这是完全正确的。我们的第二句话，加速。

content.text: Okay, so speed up and slow down.
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请继续提供需要翻译的英文内容。

content.text: So our third word for today is having a fit.
content.trans: 今天我们的第三句话是气愤。

content.text: Well, this is a funny phrase and I think listening to a few examples of this phrase
might help us understand its meaning a little bit better.
content.trans: 英语：或许可以帮助我们更好地理解它的含义。
Example one: 一台单反相机。

content.text: Geez, you don't need to have a fit.
content.trans: 英语：嘿，你不需要那么紧张。

content.text: Nothing is going to happen if we're five minutes late.
content.trans: 如果我们在五分钟内迟到，一切都会发生。

content.text: My boss is going to have a fit if I don't finish this on time.
content.trans: 我的老板如果不能按时完成这个任务，他一定会大失所望的。

content.text: I almost had a fit when my boss told me I had to work this weekend.
content.trans: 英语：我几乎要发疯了，当我老板告诉我我要在这周末加班时。

content.text: So, Erica, why don't you tell me what does it mean when you have a fit?
content.trans: 英语：所以，艾瑞克，你为什么不能告诉我当你生气时应该怎么做？

content.text: It means you get really angry and you can't control your emotions.
content.trans: 这句话意味着你非常生气，以至于无法控制你的情绪。

content.text: So maybe you start screaming and maybe some steam comes out of your ears.
content.trans: 英语：所以，也许你开始尖叫，也许有些蒸汽从你的耳朵里冒出来。
正确翻译为中文是：“正好。”

content.text: Okay, let's take a look at our next word now.
content.trans: 好的，让我们看看我们的下一个单词。

content.text: When you cut through something, it means you just go through.
content.trans: 当您穿过某物时，意味着您只是通过。

content.text: It gives you the idea that you go through something quickly.
content.trans: 英语：它让你觉得你很快乐。

content.text: So I can say let's cut through the park.
content.trans: 所以，我可以说让我们穿过公园。

content.text: Or let's cut through the backyard.
content.trans: 英语：或者让我们穿过后院。
好的，我明白了。请将需要翻译的英文内容提供给我。

content.text: And this takes us to our last word for today.
content.trans: 今天的最后一句话是：和我们今天的最后一个单词一样。

content.text: This is a really common word and not many people know about it.
content.trans: 这个是个多音字，不是每个人都了解的。

content.text: It's two simple words that when you fit them together, the meaning changes.
content.trans: 这是两个简单的单词，当你把它们组合在一起时，意义就会改变。

content.text: It's a great example of this real English we talk about.
And it means to take a shorter way somewhere.
content.trans: 这句话的意思是“意味着找到一个更短的路”。
正确翻译为中文是：“正好。”

content.text: So if I take a short cut, I go the short way.
content.trans: 所以，如果我采取短捷的措施，我会走短路。

content.text: Okay, so going back just a little bit to cut through.
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请继续提供需要翻译的英文内容。

content.text: If I cut through the park, that's basically a short cut.
content.trans: 如果我穿过公园，那基本上就是个短途。
好的，以下是“所有好”的翻译：

content.text: Now it's time to listen to our dialogue again,
content.trans: 现在是时候重听我们的对话了。

content.text: but this time it's going to be slower.
So then we can understand all these words that we've just talked about.
content.trans: 所以然后我们就可以理解这些我们在刚才聊到的词汇了。
这句话的中文翻译是：“急什么？”

content.text: The light is about to change.
I'm not going to run a red light.
The freeway will be packed at this hour.
content.trans: 这个高速公路将在今天晚上被堵。

content.text: Having a fit is not going to help.
content.trans: 有气无力是不能帮助的。

content.text: Just go down here and we'll cut through Ashburn Heights.
content.trans: 请告诉我，您需要我如何帮助您？

content.text: I'm going as fast as I can.
content.trans: 我将如飞箭般快速前进。

content.text: Well, I think that was a lot more clear this time.
content.trans: 正确翻译为中文：嗯，我觉得这次说得更清楚了。

content.text: You know, there was some great language in that dialogue
content.trans: 英语：你知道，那对话里有一些很棒的语言。

content.text: and I would like to look at how we can put it together.
content.trans: 和我一起看看我们如何组装它。

content.text: So today I'm putting it together.
content.trans: 今天我要把这台相机组装好了。

content.text: We have three phrases for you.
content.trans: 我们有三个词供您使用。

content.text: And we're going to show you how you can use these phrases
content.trans: 英语：它是我们要展示如何使用这些短语的方法。
像一位地道的汉语使用者。

content.text: So all of these phrases we heard in the dialogue.
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请继续提供需要翻译的英文内容。

content.text: Why don't we start with the first one?
content.trans: 为什么不先用第一台呢？

content.text: So in the dialogue they say make a left here.
content.trans: 英语：所以他们在对话中说，这里左转。

content.text: And we can extend this phrase to say make a right.
That would be the equivalent of saying turn left.

content.trans: 正确翻译为中文是：“正好。”

content.text: That means turn the car 180 degrees all the way around.
content.trans: 这句话的中文翻译是：这意味着将汽车旋转180度。

content.text: If you're ever in a taxi and you're telling the taxi driver
content.trans: 如果你在出租车上告诉你司机，你可以说：如果你在出租车上告诉你司机。

content.text: where to go, this is the perfect way.
content.trans: 根据提供的标准，以下是正确的翻译：
请稍等，我会将这句话翻译成中文。"Make a right there." 翻译成中文是 "请稍等，我在这里。

content.text: So let's move to our second phrase.
content.trans: 所以，让我们转到我们的第二句话。

content.text: So this is a great way of saying.
content.trans: 所以，这就是说这个好方法。

content.text: So when would we use a phrase like this?
content.trans: 英语：所以当我们使用这样的表达式时，会遇到什么问题？

content.text: If somebody has a bad idea that you don't agree with,
content.trans: 如果某人有不赞同的想法，你就不应该同意。

content.text: you would say, are you crazy or are you nuts?
content.trans: 你可以说，你是疯子还是疯子。

content.text: So Marko, let's stop this podcast right now.
content.trans: 英语：所以马克，让我们立刻停止这个播客吧。

content.text: I think that's a good example of how we can use this phrase.
content.trans: 我同意，这是用这个短语如何可以应用的例子。

content.text: So let's listen to some examples of are you nuts?
content.trans: 英语：所以让我们听听你是不是疯了？
Example one: 一台单反相机。

content.text: You want to get married now?
You only met her three weeks ago.
I'm not going to cheat on the exam.

content.trans: 英语：所以我认为这是清楚的。

content.text: And now we can move to our third phrase,
content.trans: 现在我们可以转到我们的第三句话，中文：

content.text: which is, let's take a side street.
Again, so if you're in a taxi,
this is a great way to suggest a route or suggest a direction.
So we can take this phrase and extend it out with a few more words.
content.trans: 所以我们可以将这个短语扩展出一些更多的词汇。

content.text: We might say, let's take Wilson Avenue.
content.trans: 我们或许可以这么说，让我们去Wilson大道。

content.text: So let's take a side street.
Okay, so now let's take a listen to this dialogue a third time
content.trans: 好的，现在让我们再次听一听这个对话。

content.text: And now you can understand everything that's in this dialogue.
content.trans: 现在你就可以理解这个对话中的所有内容。
英语：赶紧上车，快点出发。

content.text: No way. I meant make a right.
content.trans: 恩，明白了。请继续提供需要翻译的英文内容。

content.text: Don't worry about it, just drive.
No, the light is about to change.
content.trans: 英语：没有，光线即将改变。

content.text: I'm not going to run a red light.

content.trans: 无论怎样，就在这里右转。

content.text: The freeway will be packed at this hour.
content.trans: 高速公路将在今天上午堵车。

content.text: Geez, having a fit is not going to help.
Here, I know a short time.
content.trans: 在这里，我了解了一段时间。

content.text: Just go down here and we'll cut through Ashburn Heights.
content.trans: 请在这里走，我们将穿过安斯伯格霍恩区。

content.text: I'm going as fast as I can.
content.trans: 我将以最快的速度完成任务。
你真是个大材小用的人。

content.text: Well, this dialogue is all about driving, right?
content.trans: 嗯，这个对话主要在讨论开车，对吧？

content.text: And in North America, where both of us are from,
content.trans: 美国和加拿大，我们都是来自这里。

content.text: When did you get a car?
content.trans: 英语：当你什么时候买车？

content.text: I, well, my car I got when I was like maybe 19.
content.trans: 我，嗯，我的车。我大概在19岁的时候才买车的。

content.text: But I learned how to drive and I was driving already by the age of 16.
content.trans: 但是我在十六岁的时候就已经学会了开车了。

content.text: In many countries, you have to wait till I think you're 18 to drive.
content.trans: 英语：在许多国家，你必须等到我给你一个驾照的证明才开车。

content.text: But in North America, everyone has a driver's license by the time they're 16 years old.
content.trans: 但是，在美国，当你16岁的时候，每个人都拥有驾照。

content.text: I guess everything is so far away that you need a car.
content.trans: 英语：我猜一切都很远，你可能需要一辆车。

content.text: It's a lot less likely to have subways or trains to travel by in North America.
content.trans: 英语：它在美国南部不太可能有地铁或火车来往。

content.text: All right, so now you have all the tools necessary to give directions the next time you're in a car
content.trans: 好的，现在你已经拥有了所有必要的工具，以便在下次开车时提供路线。

content.text: Well, everyone, I really hope you enjoyed this lesson.
content.trans: 很好，大家，我真的很希望你们喜欢这节课。

content.text: Now, I want to remind you all to come to our EnglishPod website at englishpod.com.
content.trans: 现在，我要提醒大家，请各位到我们的英语播客网站 [英语播客网站地址] 了。

content.text: And here you'll find a lot of tools to help you understand our podcast better.
content.trans: 在这里，您将找到许多工具来帮助您更好地理解我们的播客。

content.text: So with that, until next time, this is goodbye.
content.trans: 英语：所以，直到下次见面，这就是再见。
